tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mgon chen gyi mdos nged rang nas gsar bsgrigs byas pa'i bsham yin// swasti/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung la brten nas nged rang gis bsgrigs pa'i mgon chen bzlog mdos kyi bshams la/ sgrub khang bris 'bur gyi sku dang spyan gzig gis brgyan pa'i lho phyogs su stegs bu bang rim lnga pa'i dang po la/ mañdzi'i khar kyai rdor maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod kyi tshom bu dam tshig bskang gso bzhin la mthar mdun bskyed kyi shar du zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ shar lhor 'thor 'thung / lhor mchod yon/ lho nub tu me tog nub tu spos dang mar me/ nub byang du dril chab/ byang du zhal zas/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin/ gnyis par mañdzi'i khar li'i maṇ+ḍal che chung gang mtshungs la/ dbus su khrag gi chos 'byung che ba/ mdun rgyab dang zur bzhi la chung ba/ 'di dag cha snyoms par 'dri tshul ni/ chos 'byung 'dris so sor thog mar zlum skor bris la de nang zur gsum du bris pas/ cha snyoms byung ba'i nang rnams kyi dbus su nas nag khrag chang tshil chen gyi dud pa mar la bsreg pa dang lhan cig tu sbrus pa'i tshom bu gru gsum dbus su che ba/ mdun du che ba dang / de'i drung du cung chung ba/ gzhan rnams la dbus ma las chung tsam/ de dag thams cad kyi zur phyi dang sdebs dbus kyi tshom bu la bsten pa/ de'i mdun du snying sna lnga/ g.yas su rnga g.yab nag po/ g.yon du nal bu'i rgyal mtshan/ de ba'i mthar shar dang shar lhor khrag gi mchod yon gnyis/ lhor dbang po'i me tog nas bzung / byang shar mtshams 'dzin gyi bar g.yas bskor du bsham/ gsum pa la gtor bsngo'i gtor ma/ bzhi pa la bskang gtor mchod pa dang bcas pa/ lnga pa la bya nag sogs phyi rten bris 'bur gang rung / de'i mdun gyi sa bzhir dbus su chos 'byung nyis rim gyi nang dmar nag phyi nag po/ gnyis ka'i phyi ljang khu/ mthar drag me bcas rtse lhor bstan che ba/ de'i g.yas g.yon mdun rnams su de bas cha gcig gis chung ba rtse lho bstan gsum/

dbus ma'i khar mañdzi'i steng du snod ji ltar rigs par mdos gdan 'jag khri la 'bru sna tshogs kyi phye ma gar sla 'tshams pa zhal ba'i tshul du byugs pa'i shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ser ba'i rtse la bshos bu nag po gru gsum pa gru gang sgor brgyan gnyis pa/ de'i mdun du mi nag gi gzugs/ zur bzhir 'jim pa'i mar me mkhyid gang pa re/ gtor ma'i rgyab dang mar me rnams kyi phyi sogs zur thams cad la mdung re/ bang rim dang po la bya nag bcu gsum dang / nam rgyang brgyad/ gnyis pa la rta nag dang lug nag nam rgyang bcu gnyis/ gsum pa la g.yag nag dang khyi nag nam rgyang bcu drug bzhi pa la mi nag dang bu med dred zhon ma rnams bcu gsum re dang / nam rgyang bzhi bcu dang / sde brgyad khram shing / pho gdong bcu gsum/ mo gdong bcu gsum/ 'phang bcu gsum/ mda' bcu drug mtha' skor du bshos bu nag po gru gsum pa mdas brgyan pa'i drung du mtheb skyu dang bcas pa bcu gsum/ ting chung ngu bcu gsum du rak+ta dang chang gis bkang ba/ dbus kyi srog shing la gur nyis brtsegs/ khyung tshang rtse gsum snga ril/ snga phod/ dar tshon sna lnga/ mdos kyi mtha' skor du/ gser gyi ri bdun/ rol mtsho/ gling bzhi/ gling phran/ lcags ri khor yug dang bcas pas bskor ba la rtsi mtshon bcas dang / de dag gi phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad rin po che 'bru sman/ zas gos lpags rigs kyi dum bu rnams cha snyoms par bkram/ de'i mdun du snod gcig gi nang nas nag rjen 'thag la lcags phye zangs phye tsha ba gsum/ bla ma gong ma'i gtor skam khrag chang chu gsum gyis sbrus pa'i gtor ma gru gsum rtse zur shin tu rno ba khrag gis byugs pa la mar lcug gi mdun sdeb la hūm̐/ g.yas su bh+yo/ g.yon du bzlog ces bris pa'i rtse zur dang yig 'bru med pa'i sdeb rnams la mtshe dang yungs dkar gyi gang bu btsugs pa mtho phyed do tsam gsum/

zur mdos ngos dang sdeb slob dpon la bstan nas/ mañdzi'i khar bkod/ g.yas su mañdzi'i khar snod kyi nang rdo zor ngos gcig la dug khrag sbyar ba'i khram ris dang / gcig la bh+yo bris pa gsum mam bdun 'ur rdo yugs skra'i rgyu la mi lpags kyi mthil ro skras ljags btags pa/ lcags snod du yungs dkar nag ke tshe shang tshe lcags zangs rdo phye thal chen rnams lhan cig tu bsreg nas dug khrag dang sbags nas skam thag bcad pa'i thun dang / 'jim kyong zur gsum pa kha gcod can du de dag blugs nas kha bcad/ mtshe sdong khrag gi bkus pa btsugs pa gsum/ gzhu'i mchog ma g.yas la las mkhan pho mo'i rbod sngags/ g.yon la rbad sngags/ mda' stong la bsad bsngags/ mde'u'i sdebs gsum la/ hūm̐ bh+yo bzlog rnams rgya snag dang dug khrag gis bri gzhu'i 'chang zung dang mda' rtse phyir bsten la bzhag g.yon phyogs su mañdzi'i steng snod gcig gi nang thod pa mtshan ngan gyi nang khrag sna dug sna sbyar ba'i rlon thun dug shing dang ro skra'i mthor g.yab bcas ra zor gsum du'ang rdzas de dag blugs la re bas kha phur tshon skud dang skyer rtsang gis bsdoms la ra rtse phyir bstan/ dug chang gis sbrus pa'i kong zor zur gsum pa gsum du'ang cung zad blug rdza gsar chags dum zur gsum mtho go tsam gsum du'ang cung zad blugs pa rnams bsham/ de dag gi mdun g.yas ngos su bsad sha sna tshogs dum bur byas pa dang / dngul dam phud phor 'chang bcas/ g.yon ngos su ling ro'i snod gtor steb dgu dang khrag gtsang chu dang sbyar ba/ de gnyis kyi bar du drag po'i mchod pa gtor ma'i mañdzi'i 'og tu lcags slang sogs snod ji ltar rigs par tsha ba gsum dang ke tshe gri khrag bag phye dang sbyar ba'i ling gzugs dod cing nyams thag pa rkang pa lcags sgrog gis bcings pa g.yas brang rdung g.yon skra 'bal ba/ mtshan ma 'phyang ba'i snying khar rus pa'i 'khor lo man ngag bzhin nam/

yang na bla dar nag po sor gang tsam pa tshon skud lngas bcing nas bcug pa'i skud sne phyir ston de'i khar khrag ris/ mtheb rgya tsam pa nar mor btab skud pa ske la se chings byas pa'i sne la lcags zangs kyi phur pa gang rung btags pa zor gtor la btsugs/ liṅga gdong ras kyi phur ba dang / gzhan yang gtor bsngo dang bskang ba'i gtor ma mchod pa bcas phyag len bzhin dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma zlum gtor 'bul gtor phud chang bcas bshams la/ mdos gtor thams cad nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug slob dpon gyi mdun du lcog tse'i khar rdor dril ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod/ 'thor nas/ g.yab dar sngags can/ gri gug phur pa yungs dkar/ sman raka rnams bsham/ sbyin sreg gi dgos cha ni/ gzhung nyid na shin tu gsal bas 'dir ma bkod do/ /las bzhi'i bro brdung gi gang du dpon slob rnams bzhugs stan las bzhugs nas gsol ja gcig srid zhi dpal 'byor mar sgrig dung rkang gling pa gnyis nas 'bud/ brjed tho'i tshul du bkod pa 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos las kyi rdo rje rnams kyi don du bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ mgon chen gyi mdos nged rang nas gsar bsgrigs byas pa'i bsham yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
